description: This file defines the internal class 'StreamConsumerCollection' which manages a collection of stream consumers, including adding, removing, checking, disposing, and activity tracking functionalities within the Orleans streaming infrastructure.

classes.name: StreamConsumerCollection
classes.description: Manages a collection of stream consumers, tracking activity and providing methods to add, remove, and query consumers.

methods.name: StreamConsumerCollection
methods.description: Constructor initializing the collection with the current time.

methods.name: AddConsumer
methods.description: Adds a new consumer to the collection and updates last activity time.

methods.name: RemoveConsumer
methods.description: Removes a consumer by subscription ID and disposes its cursor.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if a consumer exists in the collection by subscription ID.

methods.name: TryGetConsumer
methods.description: Attempts to retrieve a consumer by subscription ID.

methods.name: AllConsumers
methods.description: Returns all consumers in the collection.

methods.name: DisposeAll
methods.description: Disposes all consumers and clears the collection.

methods.name: IsInactive
methods.description: Determines if the stream is inactive based on last activity and consumer states.
